evaluation.scope: Offline lossless cache/fetch reorder, per-vertex byte checks including every morph stream; simulated cache metrics are not measured GPU timings. Packers tested with named nodes/materials, extras and quantization disabled.

godot_validation.scope: Index-only local VRMs pass application validation. Tested post-decode prototype uses built-in meshoptimizer via SurfaceTool; encoded/decoded non-index, morph, node-path and skin-bind equality. No shipped import path modified.

rendering.scope: 32 animated copies per bundled model; original/cache/cache/original, springs off, existing distance and mesh LOD. Identical map. Candidate copies retain completed original LOD buffers. Post-decode local scene candidates change only opaque/cutout base index buffers using Godot built-in meshoptimizer. No networking, combat or XR.

notes: Full cache/fetch GLB derivatives are deliberately uncompact correctness probes, not uploadable VRM outputs.
Raw VRM index reordering may change generated tangent rounding; the GPU benchmark tests the post-decode encoded-index prototype instead.
Final A/B retains original completed LOD buffers. Earlier independent-simplification trial discarded.
No production VRM importer or runtime import hook enabled. Original source VRM files and manifest untouched.
